name: cp2-b1-h2-a6-seed-confirmation
seed_policy: split_seed stays 42; per-seed shared ImageNet encoder/new decoder state; epoch RNG is training_seed + 10007 * zero_based_epoch; H2 head seed training_seed + 30003; A6 existing seed + 20200 + stage
training_policy: all phase-P settings unchanged except training seed; each seed shares source tensors and actual inputs across its three models; FP32, no AMP, one sequential trainer

selection.data: validation only, equal weighting of seeds 42/43/44
guards: mean Image Dice strictly higher than paired B1
mean total foreground misses not higher
mean empty-FP image count not higher
selection.ranking: highest mean validation Image Dice among eligible; exact ties H2 before A6; otherwise retain B1
selection.historical: seed42 screening failures remain failures; this is a separately preregistered exploratory replication, not retroactive reselection
selection.test: all models/seeds reported only after persisted validation-only decision; exposed source-test is descriptive, never used for routing
selection.routing: if BOTH H2 and A6 eligible, recommend bounded combination preregistration; if replicated mean empty-FP excess remains, recommend presence-supervision preregistration; otherwise hold/diagnose. Do not auto-launch new architectures.

scope: six fresh full runs only; no CP1 retraining, no changed labels/split/threshold/empty rules, no external data, no H3/L3/combination/presence training before result review
limitations: selection of candidates informed by reused validation; not confirmatory evidence on independent data
three seeds assess training variability on ONE duplicate-group split, not patient independence
no claim of bitwise historical GPU replay; cached seed42 original artifacts immutable
mask-empty is an annotation property, not diagnosis of healthy tissue
